title: NEW! Meticulous Manor - Scottsdale`s Finest Luxury
description:
Experience Scottsdale's epitome of luxury in this meticulously appointed manor. Live the celebrity lifestyle with an abundance of amenities, where every moment is an indulgence in the heart of Scottsdale. Fun, luxury, and relaxation await.

 The space 
Indulge in the pinnacle of luxury at this Scottsdale retreat, where every detail caters to the affluent traveler's desire for exclusivity and comfort:

Outdoors:

-Dive into the large heated pool or relax in the spacious hot tub, all set within a private oasis.

-Lounge in various outdoor seating areas, each appointed with plush, comfortable furnishings.

-Perfect your swing on the large putting green or practice at the golf net.

-Challenge friends to corn hole or enjoy a game on the basketball half court.

-Cook up a feast at the built-in BBQ station.

-Gather around the fire pit for warm, intimate evenings under the stars.

-Stay cool with misters at the patio, providing comfort during the warm summer Arizona days.

-Revel in the utmost privacy, ensuring your luxury experience remains undisturbed.

Indoors:

-Retreat to spacious bedrooms, each adorned with luxurious bedding and linens for a perfect night's rest.

-The kitchen is fully stocked, ready for any culinary adventure.

-Entertain in the game room, featuring a pool table, a bar, a card table, and multiple TVs for all your entertainment needs.

-Enjoy cinematic experiences in the dedicated movie theater.

-Admire the seamless blend of indoor and outdoor living through floor-to-ceiling glass windows.

-The separate guest house adds to your luxury with its own kitchen, living room, full bedroom, and bathroom, offering additional privacy or space for guests.

This property is a rare gem, combining magnitude with an array of top-tier amenities, offering you an unparalleled luxury travel experience. Seize this opportunity to elevate your vacation to the next level.

- - - - -

*Pool Heating*
There is an additional fee of $225 per night to heat up the swimming pool with a three night minimum.

Before booking this home, please review ALL house rules to make sure that this is the right home for you. Feel free to reach out with any questions.

Guests must be mindful of their noise levels at all times and respect the rules of the community. We do not provide speakers and/or sound systems on-site.

Smoking is not allowed on this property. Cigars are OK, outside ONLY. Violating this policy will result in forfeiture of the full security deposit and guests will be liable for the full cost of damage resulting from it
